notes:
Only es_value_r is assigned; all other fields are unassigned placeholders. Document title, authors and DOI match the assigned replication reference; supplied version is the accepted manuscript dated 19 November 2018. The description identifies the predictor and price outcome but does not identify the covariate/model specification. Several models report this relationship. The supplied p. 4 locator is a background page in this accepted manuscript, not the results page, and no PDF or alternate paginated source is supplied. Neither row order nor numeric matching was used to select a model. Candidate printed coefficients: Model 2 narrative β = 0.011, t(1,010) = 2.34, p = .020 (p. 11); Table 3 attractiveness Model 2 = 0.011 *, Model 3 = 0.012 *, Model 4 = 0.013 ** (p. 12). Extended Model 6 narrative β = 0.011, t(1,002) = 2.34, p = .019 (p. 14), while Table 4 prints 0.012 * (p. 15); this narrative/table discrepancy is retained. Exploratory categorical low/high attractiveness tests are distinct from the continuous predictor. Metric evidence, manuscript p. 9: Price, median local rent, and number of reviews were log10-transformed due to their
skewed distributions and all continuous variables were z-standardized. Printed β retained as β in candidate descriptions; no conversion to unstandardized b, fully standardized beta, or another metric was performed. No analytic N was assigned or derived. No PDF rendering was possible because source_pdf_path is null.
